notes: Pet Battle uses live hero base sprites from /pet-world/heroes/{character}/base.png as the pilot/body reference.
These PixelLab assets are mount-only flier bodies rendered underneath that hero art when available.
All downloaded PNGs were trimmed to remove transparent padding before use.
